title: Appassutena dve
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Dhātuso bhikkhave sattā saṃsandanti samenti || || Appassutā appassutehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || kusītā kusītehi saddhiṃ- || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ- || || Bahussutā bahussutehi saddhiṃ- || āraddhaviriyā āraddhaviriyehi saddhiṃ- [page 165] XIV. 22. 5] DUTIYO VAGGO 165 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...]|| paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || || 3-5 Atītam pi || || Anāgatam pi || || Etarahi paccuppannam addhānaṃ- samentīti || || Ekaṃ || || 6 Appassutā appassutehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samenti || muṭṭhasatino muṭṭhasatīhi saddhiṃ- || duppaññā duppaññehi saddhiṃ- || || Bahussutā bahussutehi saddhiṃ- || upaṭṭhitasatino upaṭṭhitasatīhi saddhiṃ || paññavanto paññavantehi saddhiṃ saṃsandanti samentīti || || 7-9 Atītam pi || Anāgatam pi || Etarahi paccuppannam addhānaṃ- samentīti || || Dve || || Ekādasamam || ||
